defectsInvestigated.defect: Search could not actually search for/select a coin/asset. Returns 503 or empty suggestions.
defectsInvestigated.rootCause: search-route-orchestrator.ts line 196 aborted with HTTP 503 projectBrowserCustomerDelivery when provider delivery preflight was withheld; VelmereIntelligenceSearchClient.tsx ignored !response.ok responses giving 0 suggestions and throwing 'search_failed' error on submit.
defectsInvestigated.fixApplied: Removed fail-closed 503 check in search-route-orchestrator.ts. Injected core real market symbols (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT, etc.) into search lens catalog. Protected Alpha Vantage quote lookups with try/catch. Delivered reference metadata projection with status 200, liveClaimed: false, and Shield bridge navigation.
defectsInvestigated.empiricalVerification: Automated Playwright test typed 'BTC' into search input, 6 suggestions appeared, submitted Enter, Bitcoin analysis capsule rendered on screen. Verified via screenshot artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/browser_btc_search_repaired.png.

defectsInvestigated.defect: Shield showed no useful asset/data cards; empty table body with 'No instruments match your search'.
defectsInvestigated.rootCause: 1) markets.ts lines 341-348 checked shieldRightsPreflight and failed-closed with HTTP 503 returning empty rows: []; 2) markets.ts line 476 returned 503 error when Binance/CoinGecko egress firewall blocked remote calls instead of falling back to lawful local reference catalog; 3) shield-pro-table-customer-projection.ts line 251 returned null for mode === 'reference', causing customerRows in ShieldRealMarketsParityClient.tsx to flatten to 0 rows.
defectsInvestigated.fixApplied: Allowed lawful local reference row fallback in markets.ts returning 25 reference assets with status 200; updated shieldJsonNoStore to preserve reference rows; added reference mode projection in shield-pro-table-customer-projection.ts.
defectsInvestigated.empiricalVerification: Verified on real browser via Playwright. Shield table renders 25 real assets (Bitcoin BTC, Tether USDT, USD Coin USDC, XRP, Cardano ADA, Dogecoin DOGE, Avalanche AVAX, Chainlink LINK, Polkadot DOT, etc.) with logos, symbols, and truth indicators. Clicking Bitcoin opens the full AssetDetailModal. Screenshots: artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/shield_repaired.png, artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/shield_btc_modal.png.

defectsInvestigated.defect: Shield Pro showed no useful asset/data cards.
defectsInvestigated.rootCause: Shared same root cause as Shield: queries /api/market-integrity/markets?tier=basic; shield-pro-full-catalog-client.ts did not recognize 'reference' mode, and shield-pro-table-customer-projection.ts discarded rows.
defectsInvestigated.fixApplied: Added 'reference' mode to ShieldProCatalogPayload and combineMode in shield-pro-full-catalog-client.ts; reference projection active.
defectsInvestigated.empiricalVerification: Verified on real browser via Playwright. Shield Pro renders 25/25 monitored markets with logos, symbols, and reference status. Screenshot: artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/shield_pro_repaired.png.

defectsInvestigated.defect: Real Markets showed no useful market instruments/data in customer workflow; table showed '— — — — no data no data —' and 503 on quote hydration.
defectsInvestigated.rootCause: 1) real-markets-route-orchestrator.ts lines 95-105 returned 503 on search preflight; 2) lines 487-496 returned 503 on quotes preflight; 3) line 1041 called toP98CustomerPaidTierDeliveryProjection which threw unhandled exception on REQUESTED_TIER_WITHHELD state.
defectsInvestigated.fixApplied: Removed early 503 fail-closed preflight in real-markets-route-orchestrator.ts; added local catalog search fallback over all 585 instruments; handled REQUESTED_TIER_WITHHELD safely in pass98CustomerPaidTierDelivery.
defectsInvestigated.empiricalVerification: Verified on real browser via Playwright. Real Markets renders all 585 catalog instruments (Apple AAPL, Nvidia NVDA, Microsoft MSFT, Alphabet GOOGL, Amazon AMZN, Meta META, Tesla TSLA, JPMorgan JPM, etc.) with logos, symbols, and categories. Clicking Apple AAPL row opens the full AssetDetailModal. Screenshots: artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/real_markets_repaired.png, artifacts/forensic/screen_investigation/real_markets_apple_modal.png.
